name: Priyank Savaliya
intro: Architect turned Interaction designer, pursuing a Master’s in Design at IIT Roorkee. I believe meaningful design begins with understanding people, and I enjoy taking an idea all the way from research to a working product.
bio: I'm an M.Des student at IIT Roorkee and a design intern at Twig Labs, an Indian ed-tech startup building financial literacy for young learners.
My work sits where UX and product design meet education and traditional Indian craft.
